affordances.label: Save
affordances.denial: Nothing changed since the file was saved.

affordances.label: Export mapgen here
affordances.description: Writes the live world's squares around you, or the marked squares, as a mapgen in a new file, keeping the open entry's symbols, and opens it in place of the open file. The open file itself is not exported.

affordances.label: Mark squares to export
affordances.description: Picks a rectangle of squares on the map for Export to write instead of whole overmap squares.

affordances.label: Extract legend to palette
affordances.description: Moves the entry's symbols into a new palette in this file, which the entry then uses.

affordances.label: Copy
affordances.denial: Mark squares with the Select tool first.

affordances.label: Cut
affordances.denial: Mark squares with the Select tool first.

affordances.label: Show advanced settings
affordances.description: Shows ids, JSON and the settings that need them, in both editors.

affordances.label: Level up
affordances.denial: No level above in this file.

affordances.label: Level down
affordances.denial: No level below in this file.

affordances.label: Preview
affordances.description: Shows under Generated map what the game makes of the entry on the square you stand on, leaving the world as it is. The number is the seed: each seed rolls the entry's random choices another way.
affordances.denial: A nested chunk goes on a map with the mapgen that places it; open that mapgen to stamp, test or preview it.

affordances.label: What can spawn here
affordances.denial: A nested chunk goes on a map with the mapgen that places it; open that mapgen to stamp, test or preview it.

affordances.label: Open mapgen here
affordances.description: Opens the mapgen of the overmap square you stand on.

affordances.label: Take back stamp
affordances.description: Puts back what the stamp replaced in the world.

affordances.label: Apply to game
affordances.description: The game makes this terrain's new squares with this entry from now on. Squares already made and the file stay as they are.

affordances.label: Apply on save
affordances.description: Switches whether each save of the file also applies the entry to the game, as Apply to game does.

affordances.label: Stamp
affordances.description: Generates the entry now over the overmap square you stand on, replacing what is there. Take back stamp undoes it.
affordances.denial: A nested chunk goes on a map with the mapgen that places it; open that mapgen to stamp, test or preview it.

affordances.label: Test
affordances.description: Puts you just south of the stamped entry, looking at it, to play there; in the editor's own world it stamps the entry first.
affordances.denial: A nested chunk goes on a map with the mapgen that places it; open that mapgen to stamp, test or preview it.

affordances.label: New mod folder
affordances.description: Puts the new file in a mod folder of its own; creating the file makes the folder a mod.
